title: ReTracing: An Archaeological Approach Through Body, Machine, and Generative Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Translating literary excerpts into choreographic prompts and video using generative AI to visualize representational biases, specifically observing the tendency of models to generate bodies frequently represented as feminized women and thereby reinforcing gender stereotypes.

Using AI-driven choreographic performance and embodied movement generation to trace and deconstruct how bodily disciplinary power, including racial identity, is inscribed within the architecture of generative systems.

Critiquing the assumption of a universal, culturally neutral body in motion synthesis models by staging human and robotic movements generated from culturally situated science-fiction literature to reveal socio-cultural biases.
